meta.title: Pengrim | Sport Advertising
meta.description: Pengrim sells LED perimeter boards, in-stadium advertising space and broadcast visibility at football matches, and runs the process from match selection to the post-match report.

hero.headline: Put your brand on the touchline.
hero.subline: We pick the match, the boards and the airtime with you.

inventory.title: Where you'll be seen
inventory.subtitle: LED boards, in-stadium space and broadcast time, in a single quote.

led.title: LED perimeter boards
led.desc: Rotating brand slots on the digital boards along the touchline, filmed head-on by the main camera.

static.title: In-stadium space
static.desc: Behind-the-goal boards, stand and tunnel branding. Fans see it from the moment they walk in.

broadcast.title: Broadcast visibility
broadcast.desc: We set your on-screen time against the camera plan up front and report it minute by minute after the match.

package.title: Packages and consulting
package.desc: We choose matches that fit your budget and audience, and handle everything from buying to the report.

feature.caption: Wherever the camera turns, your brand is in frame.

art.onScreen: Minutes the brand is on screen during the match

how.title: Matchday-ready in four steps
how.subtitle: We write down what you get at each step, and what we'll report after the match, before we start.

select.title: Match and league selection
select.desc: We choose matches, leagues and stadiums with you, based on your audience and budget.

package.title: Ad space and package
package.desc: We put together the package: LED time, in-stadium space and broadcast visibility.

approve.title: Purchase and approval
approve.desc: Contract, creative approval and placement plan, settled with a single contact.

report.title: Broadcast and reporting
report.desc: After the match we report on-screen time, camera shots and reach.

reach.title: The board in the stadium reaches living rooms
reach.subtitle: Boards are seen from the stands and on air for the whole match, and keep travelling in highlight clips afterwards.

tv.title: Live broadcast
tv.desc: The boards stay in frame for the whole match.

ott.title: Digital and OTT
ott.desc: Watched again on streaming services and in match highlights.

social.title: Social clips
social.desc: Every shared goal clip carries the boards with it.

stadium.title: In the stadium
stadium.desc: Fans in the stands have the boards in front of them for ninety minutes.

showcase.placeholder: Sample images. Real match frames will be added.

contact.title: Which match do you want to be seen in?
contact.subtitle: Tell us the matches and your budget, and we'll send the available space and pricing.
